title: Acute Stroke Triage Guidance
recommendation_blocks: Treat focal neurologic deficits with suspected acute onset as stroke until proven otherwise and activate time-critical imaging review immediately.
Document last-known-well time explicitly so thrombolysis and thrombectomy eligibility are not lost.
Escalate immediately when stroke mimic is uncertain but disabling deficits are present.

title: Seizure Classification Guidance
recommendation_blocks: Classify seizure events by onset, awareness, and motor features rather than using nonspecific convulsion labels.
Escalate first seizure, prolonged seizure, or focal deficit presentations for urgent imaging and metabolic review.
Review adherence, precipitating factors, and rescue-plan availability for patients with known epilepsy.

title: Headache Diagnostic Guidance
recommendation_blocks: Separate primary headache patterns from secondary red-flag presentations before starting routine symptomatic treatment.
Escalate thunderclap onset, progressive headache, meningitic features, or focal deficits for urgent neuroimaging or lumbar puncture.
Track disability and recurrence burden when planning prophylaxis for recurrent primary headache disorders.

title: Mental Health Screening Guidance
recommendation_blocks: Interpret mental-health screening scores alongside suicide-risk signals and functional impairment rather than score totals alone.
Escalate same-day review when self-harm risk, psychosis, severe agitation, or inability to maintain safety is present.
Document follow-up interval, safety planning, and escalation criteria explicitly when symptoms are moderate or worsening.
